authorizationGate.requiredBeforeRun: Independent parent review of this exact protocol, then explicit approval through START_POSITION_AUDIT_APPROVED=approved-by-parent.

purpose: Measure start-position resources, lawful land expansion/path accessibility, and chokepoints before considering any balance change. This protocol does not presuppose a causal mechanism, tribe buff, star change, or map-generation change.

sourceIdentityAtFreeze.sourceManifestAtExecution: Record HEAD, dirty paths, and SHA-256 for the runner, audit library, paired-matrix helper, rules, state, types, and mapgen in external output. A run from a different source identity is descriptive only and cannot be combined with this protocol's sample.

sampling.independentWorldDefinition: One unique {worldSeed, preset} generated 13x13 map. The 16 roster/rotation matches played on that map are repeated observations inside the same independent world cluster, not 16 independent maps.

expectedCounts.terrainFingerprints: Report observed unique count; do not assume it equals seeds or worlds.

sampling.randomness: For each match randomSeed equals worldSeed. The runner records the engine's realized opening order; it does not infer order from nominal seat.

recordSeparateVariables: actual opening-turn position: index of nominal seat in realized turnOrder
terrain fingerprint and full map fingerprint
resourceMetrics: immediately harvestable owned resources using shipped canHarvest
lawfulAccessMetrics: first-turn union of shipped reachableTiles for the real initial units
first-turn legally reachable neutral expansion tiles and neutral villages

minimum legal full-turn hops to each target class in a single-unit graph whose edges are recomputed solely with shipped reachableTiles while retaining the initial tribe techs, passive, unit type, unit blockers, terrain, ports, and storm rules
null legal distance, target count, and inaccessible-target count reported separately from Manhattan distance
targetClasses: unoccupied legal approach tile Chebyshev-adjacent to an opponent capital
observations.chokepointMetric: For each target class, a transit tile is a non-origin, non-target graph node whose removal makes at least one previously reachable target inaccessible. Report the union count, each target's mandatory-transit count, and the minimum legal hop distance. This directed, single-unit, frozen-initial-state graph is an accessibility diagnostic, not a claim about multi-unit play, AI policy, or future-state path availability.
observations.distanceComparator: Manhattan nearest-target distance is descriptive geometry only. It is separately named, never used as a legal-path proxy, and never substituted when legal distance is null.

outcomes.primary: 30-turn all-AI win indicator by nominal seat, with nominal seat and actual opening-turn position always reported separately.
outcomes.eligibleForPrimaryOutcome: Only gameover rows with no callback, deadline, queue, exception, invariant, or save-fixture failure. Incomplete and failed rows remain raw evidence and are summarized by preset, roster, nominal seat, opening position, and world; they are not silently dropped or replaced.

analysisPlan.estimand: Adjusted nominal-seat win-probability contrasts, separately adjusted opening-position contrasts, over the planned ordinary-map design; neither is a causal tribe-effect estimand.
analysisPlan.model: Linear probability regression on eligible tribe-match rows with nominal-seat indicators, actual-opening-position indicators, preset, roster-family, and tribe-definition indicators. Report standardized marginal predictions and all nominal-seat pairwise contrasts; do not pool nominal seat with opening position.
analysisPlan.inference: Cluster bootstrap 95% percentile confidence intervals, resampling the 32 independent {worldSeed,preset} world clusters with all their rows together; 10,000 deterministic resamples from bootstrapSeed 441009. If fewer than 24 world clusters have any eligible outcome rows, label primary inference inconclusive and do not calculate a decision signal.
analysisPlan.resourceAndAccessSummaries: For each predeclared metric report raw rows, cluster-level means, preset/roster/order-controlled estimates where finite, null/inaccessible denominators, and cluster bootstrap CIs. Do not impute null legal distances or code them as a finite distance.
analysisPlan.fingerprints: Report three noninterchangeable denominators: unique RNG seeds, unique seed/preset worlds, and unique actual terrain-layout SHA-256 fingerprints. Also report full map-layout fingerprint uniqueness. Rotations and rosters never increase an independence count.

decisionRuleBeforeMeasurement.signalThreshold: A nominal-seat contrast is a triage signal only when its absolute adjusted estimate is at least 10 percentage points and its 95% cluster-bootstrap CI excludes the practical-equivalence band from -5 to +5 percentage points in the observed direction.
decisionRuleBeforeMeasurement.inconclusive: If no contrast meets the rule; any relevant CI overlaps the -5 to +5 percentage-point band; fewer than 24 eligible independent worlds remain; map/fingerprint duplication or failures materially reduce coverage; or lawful-access patterns do not coherently support a start-position hypothesis, conclude INCONCLUSIVE. Do not tune, buff, nerf, alter stars, or change map generation from this audit.
decisionRuleBeforeMeasurement.evenWithSignal: A signal triggers only a separate diagnosis/review of map placement, opening order, resources, lawful access, and chokepoints. It does not authorize a causal claim or gameplay change.

retain: frozen scenario matrix before first match
one row per attempted match including failures
evidenceRetention.saveSeparation: The regular initial save uses humanTribe:0 and must pass loadOnlineSnapshot. The all-AI observed setup uses humanTribe:-1 and is retained separately as evidence only; it is not represented as user-loadable.
evidenceRetention.noReplacement: No seed, preset, roster, rotation, or failed row may be replaced, rerun selectively, or appended to this frozen sample. A later sample requires a new protocol identifier.

sanityOnlyExclusions.permitted: Harness tests may use test-only seeds outside the frozen blocks and must state that they are not observed sample rows.
sanityOnlyExclusions.forbidden: Do not execute any frozen seed/preset scenario before independent parent review.
